title: KHR_environment_sky Physical Sky Parameters
description: Physical skies use a physically-based model to simulate the scattering of light in the atmosphere.

groundColor.description: The tint of the ground below the horizon, multiplied by the light the ground receives from the sun and atmosphere.

mieAnisotropy.description: The anisotropy of Mie scattering (the thing that makes clouds white).

mieCoefficient.description: The coefficient of Mie scattering (the thing that makes clouds white) in inverse meters.

mieColor.description: The color of Mie scattering (the thing that makes clouds white).

rayleighCoefficient.description: The coefficient of Rayleigh scattering (the thing that makes the sky blue) in inverse meters.

rayleighColor.description: The color of Rayleigh scattering (the thing that makes the sky blue).
